comment: He's really sweet and cares about your learning. However the class is disorganized and most the class was confused

I did not enjoy this class. There is no real direction of the material and I can't think of anything that I learned that I can use in an upper-level bio class. Although he's a nice guy, the way in which he teaches is very unclear as well.

LOVE HIM!  One of the nicest teachers I have ever had.  More than willing to help at any time.  Doesn't use a textbook and the classes seem confusing and unorganized but in the end you will realize that you learned a lot.
Bell is very unclear, expects students to already know the material. Tests are hard. Not recommended
He does not take the class seriously...

A great teacher!!! He makes an effort to get to know students. He wants to see them succeed and will do anything he can to help them out! Focuses on concepts and understanding them, not memorization. :)

Wow, what a prof. He concentrates on concepts... not details. Which is great except... you don't learn details. Which i would ASSUME doesn't help in the next level of Chemistry. However, i thoroughly enjoyed this class and he's a great guy. Definitely the most entertaining chem class I've ever had.

Wonderful man! Expects his students to learn, not memorize, and he really wants what is best for the students and is enthusiatic about biochemistry. He is VERY busy though and sometimes hard to meet with or locate.

Good one on one, but can't really break concepts down for an entire class which leads to confusion.  Thinks we know moe than we do and expects a lot out of us but the grading scale makes it easier to do well than you'd think

Bell as a guy si the man. He however, expects way too much out of his students and believes that they come in wiht much more of a base then we actually do. He seems confused when no one understands him. He does however make the class itself easy by allowing extra credit. ect
Amazing lab instructor. Lets you out early every time, gives full credit just for turning in labs. Enjoyable. Very approachable. Willing to help at all times.

Bell is off of his fricken rocker.  His tests are impossible but you can make up the points and going to class is useless, however, he is a nice guy and will explain things to you if you go to see him in his office.
He's a great guy, but you learn nothing in his class--he assigns frequent papers and his tests are hard
Great Professor: very knowledgeable, not afraid to challenge students to really understand things: always ready to help a student
